name: Pareto Chart
description: Bar chart sorted by descending value with a cumulative-percentage line — the classic "vital few" tool.
whenToUse: Rank categories by frequency or by a summed value to find the vital few — with a cumulative percentage line.
placeholderPickX: Pick a category column (X) — optionally a numeric value column (Y, e.g. cost) and a grouping column (G).
